combo_label: At the Supermarket × Bees & Beekeeping × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Angular mark cut in stone or bone, carrying spells and the names of the dead
Slicing the seals off full cells so the honey can be spun out
Moving belt that carries your shopping towards the till
Sticky tree resin gathered to seal cracks and varnish the nest
Empty the lorry at the goods bay, cage by wheeled cage
Giant wolf bound by a ribbon made of impossible things, waiting to swallow a god
Vast out-of-town shed that feeds a hundred branches by nightly lorry
Pale flakes secreted from a bee's underside and moulded into cells
Mischief-maker bound in a cave beneath a serpent's venom until the last battle
God who laid his hand in a wolf's jaws as surety, and lost it when the bond held
